narrative.intro: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, from 3 awards with an average award size of $640M. Obligations are up 572.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the primary buyer, obligating $1.9B. Other reported buyers include the Department of the Interior with $239K. The company’s work is concentrated in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with $1.9B, while Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $239K. Fiscal-year obligations history shows fluctuations: FY21 was $167M, FY22 was $213M, FY23 fell to $16.1M, FY24 rose to $366M, FY25 was $285M, and FY26 is $1.9B so far. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. The dataset notes that listed award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values, while all other figures are contract obligations. Use these headline figures to assess scale, buyer concentration, and industry focus for Thalle Construction’s federal work.

sections.heading: Who are Thalle Construction's customers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the lead customer with $1.9B in obligations. The Department of the Interior is a secondary buyer with $239K. Buyer concentration is high, with most obligations tied to a single agency.

sections.heading: How has Thalle Construction's federal business changed recently?
sections.body: Obligations are up 572.6% year over year in FY2026 to date. FY26 obligations stand at $1.9B, compared with FY25 at $285M and FY24 at $366M. Historical totals show earlier years at $167M in FY21, $213M in FY22, and $16.1M in FY23.

faq.q: How much does Thalle Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Thalle Construction has received $1.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company’s federal activity in the current fiscal year comes from 3 awards with an average award size of $640M, and obligations are up 572.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Thalle Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys from Thalle Construction, obligating $1.9B. The Department of the Interior also appears as a buyer with $239K.

faq.q: What does Thalle Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Thalle Construction sells heavy and civil engineering services to the government, with $1.9B classified in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The company also has $239K in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction.
